dedupe_keys.name: pakistan health facilities spatial database alhasan systems on hdx 2017

description: This dataset is a spatial database of public and private health facilities in Pakistan, compiled by ALHASAN Systems, a private development and publishing company registered in Pakistan and Canada, under its open data and open access initiative and published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. The compiler describes it as the most up-to-date database of Pakistan's health facilities at the time, verified against several public and private data sources and used by UN agencies, donors and researchers. It covers facilities across Pakistan as points with their names and types, compiled as a census of known facilities in November 2017. The data are one compressed shapefile, free under a public-domain (CC0) dedication. Caveats: it is a 2017 snapshot that has not been updated, the compiler is a private firm, not the health ministry, and attributes such as beds, staff or services are limited. Simulation uses: placing hospitals and clinics in flood and earthquake exposure analyses for Pakistan, computing travel times to care, and seeding healthcare nodes in interdependency models. Related records: healthsites.io (data-healthsites-io) gives crowd-maintained facility points worldwide and the sub-Saharan Africa public health facilities list (data-ssa-public-health-facilities) is a comparable curated inventory.
